rinf_rfi_2026_09.publisher: European Union Agency for Railways / Rete Ferroviaria Italiana
rinf_rfi_2026_09.title: RINF dataset - RFI
limitations: A section of line is between adjacent operational points and may contain multiple tracks.
Length belongs to the section of line; maximum permitted speed belongs to a running track.
Track-to-section and project-topology mappings must be verified before importing values.

rfi_ifrp_pir_2027.title: Prospetto Informativo della Rete - Infrastruttura Ferroviaria Regionale Piemontese 2027

sfm_program_2026.title: Programma d'esercizio SFM - anno solare 2026
limitations: The published line_distance_km is a whole-trip or partial-trip distance, not a distance for every internal topology edge.
The file describes planned 2026 services and rolling-stock assignments; it does not provide acceleration or braking curves.

sfm_faq_rolling_stock.title: SFM FAQ - rolling stock used on the network
limitations: The FAQ lists families used across the SFM network, not a complete assignment by service or a technical performance dataset.

hitachi_rail_caravaggio.title: Caravaggio / Rock - technical outline
limitations: Published page confirms ETR521 five-car formation and 160 km/h maximum speed, but does not publish numeric acceleration or service-braking curves.

trenitalia_pop_technical_outline.title: Caratteristiche nuovi treni POP
limitations: Published regional POP summary reports a four-car train and 160 km/h maximum speed; exact SFM unit subtype and acceleration/braking curves are not specified.

trenord_taf_fleet.title: La flotta - TAF
limitations: Confirms TAF family configuration and 140 km/h maximum speed; does not identify the exact SFM unit or publish numeric acceleration/braking curves.

treniebinari_e464.title: Scheda tecnica locomotiva elettrica FS E.464
limitations: Locomotive-only data; does not specify Vivalto consist mass or complete train performance.
No numeric acceleration curve or service-braking deceleration curve is published.

treniebinari_taf.title: Scheda tecnica elettrotreno TAF
limitations: Family-level technical data; no numeric acceleration or service-braking curve.

treniebinari_rock.title: Scheda tecnica ETR 421/521/621 Rock/Caravaggio
limitations: Power and formation depend on ETR variant; the SFM observation is a five-car ETR521.
No numeric acceleration or service-braking curve.

treniebinari_pop.title: Scheda tecnica ETR 103/104/204 POP/Donizetti
limitations: Power and length depend on ETR variant; the SFM observation identifies a four-car ETR104.
No numeric acceleration or service-braking curve.

treniebinari_minuetto.title: Scheda tecnica elettromotrice articolata ALe 501 Minuetto
limitations: Family-level ALe501-Le220-ALe502 technical data; no numeric acceleration or service-braking curve.
